items.text: select the picture: hold it with the Input shelf open, or tap its thumbnail. Corner notches frame it; one finger moves it, two size and turn it
crop and frame: double-tap the selected picture, or Crop: drag inside to move the picture within its frame, drag a corner to crop
while a picture is selected, the Input shelf is its own pad (show, under, trace, ink, drive, auto, crop, done) and its caret points up at the picture
show and drive carry their amount as an arc round the icon
remove sits on the selected picture (a − on its corner) and in its pad, no longer on the Camera, Picture and Video rings
when the Every line changes form (turn the device, resize the window), the numbers gather into the Every dial, or spring out of it to their places

dots that are rings: in the Input ring, the camera, a picture, a video and the mic each open a ring of their own. The dot swells into the middle and its controls bloom round it: front and back, mirror, show, ground, trace, ink, drive, remove; the mic's gain, gate and heard. The arrow at the top, or a tap on the middle, goes back
the numbers on the Every line shrink together to fit, always round, while the unit, the dials, the pill and the dice stay full size; the dial form only when the numbers would get too small
every circle on the Every line is one size and always round; the numbered beads show only when they all fit, otherwise the Every dial
the pair / fibo / prime pill keeps one width, so the line no longer shifts
with the dice on, the Every circle shows the number the dice picked and a ring runs round it until the next scene
Updating shows it is working: the button pulses and a bar fills until the new version opens
one box heads the scenes' ticks: ticked when every scene is in play, a dash when some are; ALL / NONE are gone
the Touch tab scrolls on a phone
the tap button keeps one width, so the sound shelf no longer shifts when the tempo shows
the band under an open shelf matches the shelf in light mode
solo lasts one visit: it clears when Current reopens, so a forgotten solo never silences a scene (mute still saves)
"the sound stopped" no longer shows when the silence is your own mix (solo, mute or a level at zero)
Update works on the first tap: it says Updating… and the new version opens within a second or two
when a newer version is out, the index says so in Version, with its own Update button
